name: North Fork of the White River (North Fork River) — Hebron Access to Patrick Bridge Access
gaugeName: North Fork River near Tecumseh, MO (USGS 07057500)
blurb: North Fork of the White River (North Fork River) in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation and U.S. Forest Service accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Hebron Access: approximate area only. Take-out North Fork Recreation Area: approximate area only. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.sourceName: Missouri Department of Conservation — Hebron Access (area page)
putInAccess.note: Public river access is documented by Missouri Department of Conservation — Hebron Access (area page). The coordinate is MDC Conservation Area centroids (Discover Nature atlas) — area centroid; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: the MDC record is a conservation-area centroid, not a launch feature.
putInAccess.directions: From the junction of Highways 14/63, take Highway 14 west 17 miles, then County Road 279 north 2 miles.

takeOutAccess.operator: USDA Forest Service — Mark Twain National Forest
takeOutAccess.sourceName: USDA Forest Service, Mark Twain NF — EDW Recreation Opportunities record
takeOutAccess.note: Public river access is documented by USDA Forest Service, Mark Twain NF — EDW Recreation Opportunities record. The coordinate is USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities (Mark Twain National Forest), OBJECTID 6718; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: imagery verdict 'flag': Pin roughly 40-150 m from the water in woods, a campground or a parking area; launch spot not identifiable at the pin. Coordinate kept only as an area centre.
takeOutAccess.directions: Approximate area only: North Fork Recreation Area (USFS) as listed by USDA Forest Service — Mark Twain National Forest. Follow agency signs from the public road to the river; launch only at the public access.
